messages:
tom: Hey sec team — I need a short admin window (~45m) to run a retention sample and do a redaction sanity check on the prod logs for the compliance audit. I won't export full logs, just a small sample and then run the redaction script.

maria: @tom can you clarify which indices and which columns/fields you'll access? Also what's the exact command so we can scope the JIT grant?

tom: Planning to pull from: logs-prod-2025-* index, filter on service:ingest and timeframe last 90 days. Fields: timestamp, service, message, user_id (user_id will be redacted in the sample). Command I plan to run:

```bash
elasticsearch-sample-pull --index logs-prod-2025-* --query 'service:ingest AND @timestamp:[now-90d TO now]' --size 250 --fields timestamp,service,message,user_id --out /tmp/retention-sample.json
python tools/redact_sample.py /tmp/retention-sample.json --redact user_id --dry-run
```

I will not move the file off the instance; results stay on workstation and I'll paste redaction diff here. Requesting sudo on one ops jumpbox and read-only access to the ES cluster for the sample. Window: today 16:00-16:45 UTC.

zoe: Who's oncall for infra tonight? Need them to ack if there are any running jobs that this might conflict with.

devops-bot: @zoe oncall (infra) is sam for 2025-06-12 00:00 - 23:59 UTC.

maria: @sam can you review and ack? We need: 1) justification (audit), 2) exact scope (indices/fields), 3) window & duration. If approved we'll issue a JIT sudo token scoped to the single jumpbox and a limited ES read role for 45m.

sam: Ack — I reviewed the commands. Fine with read-only ES and jumpbox sudo for 45m. Please ensure no bulk exports and run in an ephemeral tmp dir. I'll approve the JIT if you add the audit ticket ID in the request.

tom: Thanks — audit ticket A-2025-1987. I'll add that when requesting the JIT. Also will run `sha256sum` on the sample and record checksums before/after redaction.

maria: Approved with condition: create the JIT request via the admin console, include A-2025-1987 in justification, tag it with `retention-audit`, and set expiration 45m. No external copies allowed. Post the redaction diff here when done.

sam: Granting temporary approval now — please go ahead at 16:00 UTC. If anything unexpected pops up ping #eng-oncall and me directly. :thumbsup:

tom: Will do. I'll post status updates here (start, sample size, redaction diff). Appreciate the quick turnaround.

maria: Adding note: security will follow up with a tiny verification script to validate that user_id fields are removed from the posted sample. Expect a short DM.

tom: Copy.

(END)
